dataset_name: Ruchi South Indian Recipe Dataset — 200 Recipes

methodology.selection: Curated coverage of famous, common household, regional, temple, tiffin, rice, curry, snack, sweet and non-vegetarian South Indian dishes; not a strict numerical popularity ranking.
methodology.regional_basis: South Indian cuisine is highly regional and includes distinct Andhra, Telangana, Tamil, Karnataka/Udupi, Kerala and related sub-cuisines.
methodology.recipe_basis: One-person standardized home-cooking baselines intended for an AI cooking assistant. Traditional recipes vary by household, region and desired serving size.
methodology.measurement_policy: Quantities are explicit and machine-readable. Where a recipe traditionally uses 'to taste' or 'as needed', the dataset retains that semantic instead of fabricating false precision.

steps.instruction: Bring the measured water to a rolling boil, add half the salt, add the drained rice, and cook until the grains are about 70% cooked. Drain immediately.

steps.title: Build the masala
steps.instruction: Heat the oil/ghee, add onion and cook until light golden. Add ginger-garlic paste, green chilli and the recipe spices. Cook until the raw smell disappears.

steps.instruction: Spread the parboiled rice over the masala. Add mint and coriander. Sprinkle the remaining salt only if needed after tasting the masala.

steps.title: Dum cook
steps.instruction: Cover tightly and cook until the rice is fully tender and the protein/vegetables are cooked through. Rest covered before opening.
